instruction: Review the Batch D combined head cd7c4514c (cars #550, #556, #554, #509 in batch order) on base main a6a0b0d73d77, and disposition it as ready to land after its checks are green, given that the two conflicts were hand-resolved as additive unions and that the rule-8 files are byte-identical to the head already signed off by a non-author reviewer.
acceptance: Combined head is cd7c4514c130e65ccc4398fdd3e305164a4e911a, built from main a6a0b0d73d7720da6c0218180497f1c48bd20a8d, containing the four Batch D cars as four merge commits in batch order b00a95808, a1feec389, ececa3a1ab, cd7c4514c.
The batch scope is 23 files, +2318/-254, with no build artifacts and no secrets.

The NetworkDetector.kt conflicts are additive: the logging gate val changed is kept together with lastPhysicalType bookkeeping and the notifyNetworkChange call, and both top-level declarations shouldLogNetworkTypeTransition and NetworkAvailability are kept because each is called in the same file.

The rule-8 files core/src/routing/local.rs, core/src/routing/optimized_engine.rs, core/src/transport/swarm.rs and core/src/identity/keys.rs are byte-identical at this head to the car 3/4 head that already carries an independent non-author rule-8 sign-off, verified by git object hash equality.
Main introduced no gated changes between the review base 2677ea38d7 and this head, so no unreviewed gated code arrives through the base.

Untrusted announce lists are bounded before the routing lock in IronCore::routing_update_peer_hints: parse to 8 bytes, dedupe, take max_peer_hint_budget 128, inject the direct hint, and ignore unknown peers.

The local cell enforces a per-peer budget of 8 plus 120 times reliability and a global budget of max(1, peers) times 64 with a 90 percent low-water mark, evicting lowest reliability then oldest, with direct hints exempt.

The identify arm now routes through IronCore::routing_peer_seen, which length-bounds the transport, parses the peer id to 32 bytes, rejects all-zero ids and fails closed, and the removed transport_type_to_routing_transport had no remaining callers.

The conflict resolution in section 2 of the review record was authored by this lane, so under Amendment 6 it still needs a non-author read of those two hunks; the rule-8 verdict carried here is the non-author reviewer's on #554 and is not reissued by this document.

mobile.yml android jobs are executing on this head (Android JVM Unit Tests and Android Debug APK in progress, Android Wiring Gate success), and security.yml is dispatched on this branch because it is schedule or manual only.
